name: Brake
tagline: Names the recurring job quietly draining your Grok Bot allowance and tells you to kill it
description: Point it at everything you already have running and it audits the lot, working out where your allowance is actually going. It comes back with a single verdict: the one repeating job costing you the most, plus a plain instruction to switch that one off. It deliberately starts no fresh work of its own.

source.excerpt: Shared as a brake pedal for anyone running so many bots they have lost track of which one is eating the budget.

body:
## What it does

Point it at everything you already have running and it audits the lot, working out where your allowance is actually going. It comes back with a single verdict: the one repeating job costing you the most, plus a plain instruction to switch that one off. It deliberately starts no fresh work of its own. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @FantomBuildz shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
